item.text: I’ll trace the v27 movement decode path and its callers, then make the smallest version-scoped correction so older and newer clients remain untouched. I won’t run tests unless you ask, per the project rules.

The decoder is isolated to `com.rdforward.protocol.v27`; its use of `Math.round(fixed / 32.0f)` turns values such as `-63` into `-2`. Java integer division gives the required truncation toward zero (`-63 / 32 == -1`) without affecting exact coordinates.
